cases.brief: Show the water cycle as a clear loop. Let the child reveal a short explanation for each stage.
Show how warm water becomes vapor, condenses into a cloud, and falls as rain. Make each step selectable.
Show the Sun, Earth, and Moon with readable labels and clear orbital relationships. Let the child reveal one fact.
Show four stages from seed to flower and let the child reveal the final stage.
Compare a seed and a flower side by side. Let the child select either one to continue the conversation.
Make a simple non-graphic heart diagram with three clearly labeled parts and tap-to-reveal notes.
Show a three-event timeline with uncluttered dates and let the child select an event.
Show how sunlight causes a puddle to shrink, using a clear cause-and-effect flow and one reveal.
Show a number line from zero to ten with a large draggable marker and a reset control.
Revise the current water-cycle scene by adding collection while preserving every concept and stable node ID that remains.
